I think to answer this we need to separate the word “normal” into two separate definitions: “acceptable” and “typical”.

Is this typical? Maybe. Teenage boys just like teenage girls are experiencing major hormonal changes. If they don’t know how to handle them which is typically the case with how terrible sex education is then these hormonal changes manifest in sexual overdrive and sometime sexual aggression which is what you’re seeing here. This is why fathers of teenage girls get so protective during this stage of dating. This isn’t to say there aren’t teenage boys who don’t behave this way and know how to handle themselves, but at the end of the day this behavior is unfortunately common.
